description: Verify a wallet signature: EIP-191 personal_sign messages, EIP-712 typed data, or a full Sign-In with Ethereum (EIP-4361) message with domain, nonce and expiry checks. Smart-contract wallets are verified with ERC-1271 / ERC-6492, not just EOAs. Costs $0.002 USDC per call (x402).
